name: roadquiz-tesla-mvp
description: Tesla passenger quiz MVP - no external npm dependencies

scripts.start: node -e "const h=require('http'),o=h.createServer,s={startedAt:new Date().toISOString(),counts:{},visitors:new Set()};console.log('RQ_ANALYTICS ready');h.createServer=f=>o.call(h,(q,r)=>{const u=new URL(q.url,'http://x'),m=u.pathname.match(/^\/__rq_event\/([a-z0-9_-]+)$/);if(q.method==='GET'&&m){const e=m[1],v=u.searchParams.get('visitor');s.counts[e]=(s.counts[e]||0)+1;if(v)s.visitors.add(v);console.log('RQ_ANALYTICS event='+e+' count='+s.counts[e]+' unique='+s.visitors.size);r.writeHead(204,{'Cache-Control':'no-store'});return r.end()}if(q.method==='GET'&&u.pathname==='/api/analytics'){r.setHeader('content-type','application/json');r.setHeader('cache-control','no-store');return r.end(JSON.stringify({startedAt:s.startedAt,uniqueVisitors:s.visitors.size,counts:s.counts}))}return f(q,r)});require('./bootstrap-safe')"
